prompt: In the Splice project {project}, hide the mouse cursor from second 3 to second 5 of the recording only. Everywhere else the cursor stays visible and twice its normal size. Do not change the video's length. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: hidden from 3 to 5 s
checks.expr: all(any(c['start'] <= s * project['fps'] < c['start'] + c['length'] and param_at(look('cursor', c['id']), 'hidden', s * project['fps'] - c['start']) is True for c in clips) for s in [3.2, 4.0, 4.8])

checks.name: visible and 2x elsewhere
checks.expr: all(any(c['start'] <= s * project['fps'] < c['start'] + c['length'] and not param_at(look('cursor', c['id']), 'hidden', s * project['fps'] - c['start']) and abs((param_at(look('cursor', c['id']), 'size', s * project['fps'] - c['start']) or 1) - 2) < 0.15 for c in clips) for s in [1.0, 2.5, 5.5, 7.0])
